1719-4613-6859.easyPrerequisites:
Servant of Tymaret doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vizier of Tumbling Sands is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1719-4613-6859.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1719-4613-6859.description:
Activate Servant of Tymaret using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Vizier of Tumbling Sands's ability by tapping it, untapping Servant of Tymaret
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

2757-4222-8230.description:
Activate a basic Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Seedship Agrarian.
Seedship Agrarian triggers, creating a Lander token
Resolve the Earthcraft ability, untapping a basic Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Seedship Agrarian.
Repeat.

512-527-5475.easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
512-527-5475.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
512-527-5475.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{W}
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Forensic Researcher and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-527-5475.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Selvala's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6968-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
3259-6968-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6968-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

586-1739-5258-5618-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
586-1739-5258-5618-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1580-4871-5075-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Ogre Slumlord trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2499-3821-4415.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}.
2499-3821-4415.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying its mana cost.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3490-5231-6752-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-5231-6752-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3129-3899-4478.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2921-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2116-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Spiteful Squad.
When Spiteful Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
2116-5686-6972.notes: When Spiteful Squad dies with a +1/+1 counter on it, that counter can be placed onto another creature. If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, it will be removed, allowing it to be returned via persist.

4067-6281-7013-7327.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
4067-6281-7013-7327.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ragamuffin Raptor.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Ragamuffin Raptor that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Ragamuffin Raptor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ragamuffin Raptor from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2646-4559-5256-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2646-4559-5256-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3621-5256-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
3621-5256-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

3096-3832-6723.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck is empty
Activate Jace's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to win the game due to drawing from an empty library.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7159.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

49-2034-3375-4871-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to The Immortal Sun.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3713-5078-5243-6723.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

856-1379-3698-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it, Grinding Station and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
When the Munitions token enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1003-2173-3698-5220.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Phyrexian Walker enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Repeat.

575-3381-5971.easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-3381-5971.description:
Activate Morgue Toad by sacrificing it, adding {U}{R}.
When Morgue Toad dies, Yedora triggers, returning Morgue Toad from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Morgue Toad enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Morgue Toad by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Morgue Toad face-up.
Repeat.

1350-2793-6263.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Mendicant Core triggers, copying the Ugin's Nexus spell.
Resolve both Ugin's Nexus spells.
The token Ugin's Nexus is put into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Ugin's Nexus from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

4222-6006-6210.easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Neerdiv.
4222-6006-6210.notablePrerequisites: Neerdiv does not have summoning sickness.
4222-6006-6210.description:
Activate Neerdiv by tapping it, adding {U}.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Neerdiv.
Repeat.

64-1987-2104-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
64-1987-2104-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Temporal Manipulation during your draw step.
Repeat.

527-2511-5140.manaNeeded: {G}, plus {R} if Selvala has summoning sickness
527-2511-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater that isn't Selvala.
527-2511-5140.description:
If Selvala has summoning sickness, activate Kenrith's first ability by paying {R}, giving all creatures haste until end of turn.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {4}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Selvala, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
527-2511-5140.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

2556-2781-4617-4906-6084.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You have not activated Soulbright Flamekin's ability more than twice this turn.
2556-2781-4617-4906-6084.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Felidar Guardian's trigger, targeting each other creature you control except Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the copies of Felidar Guardian's trigger targeting Soulbright Flamekin and Mnemonic Wall, blinking Soulbright Flamekin and Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Deflecting Swat from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Deflecting Swat by paying {0}, changing any of the remaining Felidar Guardian triggers not targeting Agrus Kos to target Agrus Kos instead.
Repeat from step 6.

3401-5056-5803.manaNeeded: {11}{U}{U}{U} minus {1} for each other artifact you control
3401-5056-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3401-5056-5803.description:
Activate Neurok Transmuter's first ability by paying {U}, causing Kitsa to become an artifact.
Cast Blinkmoth Infusion by paying {12}{U}{U}, minus {1} for each artifact you control.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of mana-producing artifacts you control, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Blinkmoth Infusion.
Resolve the copy of Blinkmoth Infusion, untapping all artifacts you control.
Repeat from step 4.

4798-5014-5631-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4798-5014-5631-5686.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
Repeat.

612-2791-2803-3750.notablePrerequisites:
Mark of Sakiko and Sticky Fingers attached to the same Doctor or creature with changeling you control that has power 2 or greater and that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block the creature with Sticky Fingers and Mark of Sakiko attached.
612-2791-2803-3750.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Mark of Sakiko and Sticky Fingers attached.
The creature triggers four times.
Resolve the first two triggers, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Resolve the last two triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

413-474-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying {1}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Specimen Collector.
When the Specimen Collector token enters the battlefield, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Specimen Collector trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
When the Squirrel and Crab enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve the Blasting Station triggers from step 2 and step 4, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the nontoken Specimen Collector.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a token copy of the Specimen Collector token.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities, dealing infinite damage to any target(s).

305-1247-2979.notablePrerequisites: Patchwork Crawler does not have summoning sickness.
305-1247-2979.description:
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Llanowar Tribe's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2350-5078-5243.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

708-2459-4050-4948.notablePrerequisites: Estrid's Invocation is a copy of Myth Unbound.
708-2459-4050-4948.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Repeat.

486-905-3263-4853.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Liquimetal Torque.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1298-2430-4050.description:
Cast Petals of Insight by paying {4}{U}.
Ovika triggers, creating five 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin tokens that gain haste until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Phyrexian Goblins, adding {4}{U}.
Resolve Petals of Insight, putting the top three cards of your library on the bottom of your library and returning Petals of Insight to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite storm count and have the card of your choice on top of your library, you may draw three cards in step 4 instead, ending the loop.

821-4763-4766.description:
Sacrifice Mogg Fanatic to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll and Deathrender trigger.
Stack the triggers so that Koll's trigger resoves first.
Koll returns Mogg Fanatic to your hand.
Deathrender's trigger resolves, putting Mogg Fanatic from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Bala Ged Recovery // Bala Ged Sanctuary

1065-2573-4270-4872.notablePrerequisites:
Must be able to produce 6UUG on each of your turns.
Must be able to play a land this turn.
1065-2573-4270-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp targeting yourself.
Cast Bala Ged Recovery targeting Time Warp.
Play Bala Ged Santuary from your graveyard.
Return Bala Ged Sanctuary to your hand with Trade Routes.
Pass the turn to yourself.
Repeat.

2103-2493-4428.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
